RWA.note: Draft law gives virtual-asset oversight to the Capital Markets Authority; no payments mandate, licensing or switch stated.
Virtual-asset draft law only; no digital financial services consumer rules or complaints body stated.

facts.fact: The Capital Markets Authority and National Bank of Rwanda published the draft law regulating virtual assets business on 6 March 2025 and invited public comments by email to 14 March and at a virtual Zoom consultation on 17 March 2025.
facts.system: Draft Law Regulating Virtual Assets Business
